name: ExTensor LLB
assumptions: Exactly four independent 7.5 MiB logical banks, totaling 30 MiB.
Two RW ports per bank, following shared_SRAM's n_bank_rd_ports + n_bank_wr_ports conversion.
Whole-word writes; no independent byte or bit write masks.
Use multiplicity four rather than the upstream inclusive SRAM_bank[0..nbanks] range.
Macro footprints only: crossbars, controllers, external routing and timing closure are excluded.
